resources.string: E03 Android 9: music stream 3 and navigation stream 12. A rejected route reports an error; it does not switch to usage routing. The car handles ducking. Takes effect at the next connection. Does not enable volume-key interception or change factory navigation.

Next connection: music stream 3 / navigation stream 12. The car stores each volume separately; on-car playback is not yet verified. Change the mode in Advanced. Saved upstream routes remain unchanged.
